\* = not a board part. **camera:** not soldered; module sits on the board (or taped to the cover), lens under the drilled window. **LiPo:** rev E: Adafruit #1317 flat on the back-cover floor under the solar-box zone (ground flat), 2.2 mm under the board, 0.3 mm under the LR44 cup (kept); its margin row counts the floor-to-board space (6.0) only. **magnet:** stage 13b: body in front of the board edge (y 57.3-61.3), centred 1.3 mm above the F side, spanning 2.2 below to 4.8 above it; legs straightened into J3 (right-angle header). The LiPo row is the floor-to-board space (6.0) minus the cell (3.8): the real limit is the LR44 cup in the faceplate (0.3 mm, assembly_report.md section 9).

Front shell: LR44 cup (centre 168.3, 69.0, outer dia 14); magnet slot (top wall) at [116.75, 56.9]-[138.25, 58.6]; antenna relief (inner rib) at [114.15, 71.5]-[115.15, 106.5]. See the grind list on grind_map_front_shell.svg.
